question: Which agency conducted Operation Fire Trail?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**DRI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• DRI foils major smuggling bid, seizes ₹35 crore worth of Chinese firecrackers in “Operation Fire Trail”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Operation Fire Trail** was a major anti-smuggling crackdown.

 
 
• 
 
It was led by the **Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI)**.

 
 
• 
 
The DRI seized **₹35 crore worth of banned Chinese firecrackers**.

 
 
• 
 
The operation targeted **illicit imports** through Indian **ports**.

 
 
• 
 
Banned firecrackers pose **environmental**, **legal**, and **safety** risks.

 
 
• 
 
The DRI operates under **CBIC (Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs)**.
